summary.text: Rosalba Dominguez is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 35 who took office on January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Rosalba Dominguez earned an associate degree in graphic design from Salt Lake Community College and a bachelor's degree in film and video production from Brooks Institute of Photography, according to Ballotpedia.
She has served on the Murray City Council and succeeded Mark Wheatley as the representative for District 35.
